articles.title: Dartmouth endowment’s crypto exposure drops by $2M amid falling prices
articles.description: The value of the university endowment’s holdings in the Bitwise Solana staking ETF, Grayscale Ethereum staking ETF and BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin ETF dropped to about $12 million.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward revenue rises 17% as trading volume falls in Q2
articles.description: Payward grew revenue despite weaker crypto spot activity, as funded accounts jumped 42% and a growing share of revenue came from outside transaction-based activity.

articles.title: UK authorities continue probe into Nigel Farage’s crypto ‘gifts’ after by-election win
articles.description: The UK lawmaker declared victory following a by-election, triggering a resumption of an investigation from the parliamentary commissioner for standards into his crypto donations.

articles.title: Israel’s largest bank taps Galaxy to offer Bitcoin, Ether, Solana trading
articles.description: Bank Leumi customers will be able to buy, hold and sell three major cryptocurrencies directly through the bank’s investment app beginning in early 2027.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s $116M self-custody wake-up call
articles.description: A $116 million Bitcoin wallet exploit puts self-custody under scrutiny as ETF inflows rebound, Strategy eyes more BTC and miners chase billions in AI deals.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Bitcoin price drops to $62.5K as trader warns weekly close may spark more losses
articles.description: Bitcoin falls further toward new August lows, ignoring positive US inflation trends while US stocks continue to circle all-time highs.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley’s BlackRock Bitcoin ETF holdings rise 23% in Q2
articles.description: Morgan Stanley’s reported IBIT holdings rose to 16.5 million shares in Q2, while Ether ETF positions and several crypto-linked stocks also increased.

articles.title: JPMorgan boosts Bitcoin, Ether ETF positions in Q2 filing
articles.description: JPMorgan reported a 25% increase in its Bitcoin ETF position and more than quadrupled its Ether ETF position in the second quarter.

articles.title: Binance to restrict transactions involving HTX, 10 other crypto platforms
articles.description: Binance said it will stop processing transactions for involving 11 crypto platforms, including HTX, which was recently listed in the EU’s sanctions package targeting Russia.

articles.title: Solana’s fee overhaul increases burn and makes resource hogs pay
articles.description: Solana’s proposed fee overhaul would make resource-heavy transactions more expensive while cutting costs for simpler activity, and it increases the amount of SOL burned.

articles.title: Gemini posts $108M Q2 net loss despite 37% revenue growth
articles.description: Credit card and staking revenue drove Gemini’s services growth in Q2 as exchange revenue fell 38% and trading volume dropped by two-thirds.

articles.title: Shinhan Asset Management partners with Plume on tokenized fund pilot
articles.description: Shinhan Asset Management and Plume will test a tokenized fund using a Korean won-denominated ultra-short-term bond fund as its underlying asset.

articles.title: Bitcoin eyes new August lows as Binance longs face ‘cleanout’
articles.description: Bitcoin futures open interest on Binance fell alongside BTC price as analysis published on CryptoQuant flagged mounting pressure on leveraged longs.

articles.title: RedotPay US IPO delayed amid regulatory, legal hurdles: Report
articles.description: RedotPay’s US IPO has reportedly been delayed as it seeks regulatory approvals, while the company says it secured a US money transmitter license.

articles.title: JPMorgan cuts Polymarket banking ties over regulatory concerns: Report
articles.description: JPMorgan Chase reportedly cut banking ties with Polymarket in October 2025 over regulatory concerns but remains open to an underwriting role if the platform goes public.

articles.title: Crypto payments barely register among euro area merchants, ECB finds
articles.description: Crypto acceptance was just 0.2% online and remained below 1% at physical points of sale, while mobile payments gained ground.

articles.title: SEC cancels key crypto regulatory meeting
articles.description: The SEC canceled a meeting on proposed crypto offering rules after the Senate left for recess without voting on the CLARITY Act.

articles.title: Neutrl pauses NUSD redemptions over undisclosed reserve issue
articles.description: BA Labs had previously classified a proposed NUSD integration as higher risk because of its counterparty, operational and liquidity exposure.

articles.title: Figure reports $4.3B in loan marketplace volume as profit nearly triples
articles.description: Figure expects consumer loan marketplace volume to range from $4.8 billion to $5.2 billion in the third quarter.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation pivots away from Poseidon in post-quantum plan
articles.description: Advances in compact proofs have erased Poseidon’s previous performance advantage, according to researcher Justin Drake.

articles.title: City of Baltimore goes after prediction markets for sports betting
articles.description: The city’s complaint over gambling laws and deceptive trade practices included Robinhood, Webull and Coinbase as partners with prediction market platform Kalshi.

articles.title: Tether completes first full financial audit, receives clean KPMG opinion
articles.description: KPMG’s audit covered Tether’s 2025 financial statements and found its reserves exceeded liabilities by $6.8 billion.

articles.title: Delio CEO sentenced to 15 years in prison on crypto fraud in South Korea
articles.description: More than a year after being indicted on fraud charges related to his activities at crypto company Delio, Jeong Sang-ho faces prison time in South Korea.

articles.title: CFTC to join SEC in exploring crypto regulations without CLARITY bill
articles.description: The CFTC will hold a meeting for its Innovation Advisory Committee on Aug. 20 to address regulation related to crypto assets, artificial intelligence and prediction markets.

articles.title: Crypto group backs Custodia in Supreme Court battle over Fed access
articles.description: The Blockchain Association argues the Fed should not have broad discretion to deny eligible state-chartered banks direct access to its payment system.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain nears $1B TVL as Uniswap drives liquidity: Standard Chartered
articles.description: Standard Chartered said Robinhood’s Uniswap integration could solve a key challenge for new blockchains while accelerating UNI token burns.

articles.title: Public Bitcoin miners cut hashrate 13.4% as AI infrastructure revenue grows
articles.description: AI and HPC are reshaping mining economics as operators repurpose power and data centers, while a smaller group of miners continues to expand Bitcoin capacity.

articles.title: Bullish shares jump 10% as Q2 adjusted EBITDA more than triples
articles.description: The crypto exchange operator’s shares gained around 10% as adjusted EBITDA more than tripled and subscription and services revenue hit a record high.

articles.title: Trezor reports data from 14K users exposed through shipping provider
articles.description: The wallet provider warned that thousands of users could potentially be at risk of phishing attempts, while advising that all devices, private keys and backups were safe.
